MCU wiki: affiliation Carbone Crime Family; 'the leader of the Carbone Crime Family' throughout Luke Cage S2 (War for Harlem) and Daredevil S3, where she only buys protection from Fisk as an outside crime boss and does not join him. Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episode 8 (The Well): Jakob Nystrom leads and Petra Larsen is a leading member of a Norse Paganist hate group/cult; they lead their followers in riots in Oslo and to Ireland for the staff. MCU wiki affiliation for both: Norse Paganists. New name, wiki names it plainly.

owner_calls.question: Is Vin-Tak a member of the Kree Empire during Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. episode 34?
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: a Kree warrior, citizenship Kree Empire, but he comes to Earth on his own initiative to destroy the Diviners before the Kree Empire learns the experiments worked, and he is not shown acting for the Empire.
